Story

Hi, I'm John Rain B. Lutong, a BS Computer Science student at the University of the Cordilleras.

My love for technology began at Tadian School of Arts and Trades, where I studied Computer Systems Servicing and learned the basics of computers, hardware, and troubleshooting.

Goals

I want to sharpen my skills, explore new ideas, and build solutions that make everyday tasks easier.

I chose Computer Science because I love learning how things really work. Every challenge is a chance to grow, and this portfolio shows what I have learned and the goals I'm working toward.
